description: SOTI ONE Platform is a software designed to facilitate the management and security of mobile devices and endpoints across various operating systems. The software enables organizations to streamline the deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of connecteddevices, applications, and data. It offers features for device management, mobility administration, remote support, and application lifecycle management. Through integrated modules, the software aids in reducing downtime and optimizing device performance while providing visibility into device usage and compliance. SOTI ONE Platform addresses business needs related to operational efficiency and risk mitigation, allowing organizations to manage their mobile and IoT environments from a unified interface.
